news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 21%
news.body: After last week's 21% share price gain to ₹32.70, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 9.9x. Average trailing P/E is 15x in the Construction industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 21% over the past three years.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.7% average weekly change). Market cap is less than US$100m (₹7.07b market cap, or US$75.8m).

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 4 experienced directors. 3 highly experienced directors. Additional Non-Executive Independent Women Director Tara Subramaniam was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹9.07b (US$99.9m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.41 (vs ₹3.38 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.41 (down from ₹3.38 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.49b (down 15% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹92.8m (down 88% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.7% (down from 26% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was primarily driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 8% per year.
